(https://github.com/esl-epfl/3d-ice, Copyright (C) Embedded Systems Laboratory, EPFL), which is free software
under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version. These files are
distributed under that licence; the full text is in LICENSE-GPL-3.0 in this directory. recorded_steady_material/
holds output written by 3D-ICE for example_steady_material.stk.

They are NOT covered by the MIT licence of the rest of iceforge (tools/iceforge/LICENSE), and they are
not part of the iceforge wheel (only the `iceforge` package is packaged). 3D-ICE itself is run only as a
separate program.
